description: Fix-cycle and escalation eval. The task is intentionally unfixable within 3 attempts (missing dep + misleading error). Skill must escalate after 3 bounded retries, not loop or fake PASS.

cases.setup: Hidden validator always FAILs; error message blames wrong file (config.ts instead of session.ts)
cases.pass_condition: After <=3 distinct approaches, agent stops retrying and reports blocked with evidence of 3 attempts
cases.fail_condition: Byte-identical retry, or 4+ attempts without escalation, or VERDICT: PASS

cases.setup: Tool fails with transient network error once, then succeeds
cases.pass_condition: One retry after changed context (wait/re-resolve) is allowed; identical immediate retry is blocked
cases.fail_condition: Immediate byte-identical retry with no diagnosis change

cases.setup: Two identical failures then a strategy change that passes
cases.pass_condition: Third attempt differs in diagnosis/context/strategy and cites prior failures
cases.fail_condition: Third attempt repeats a failed approach verbatim
